name: Eldrius Online
storyline: In the ancient world of Kaldraen, Eldrius, the Crimson Dragon and firstborn of Kaldraen, was sealed away within the forgotten lands of Thar’Ael. As the forces that once kept him imprisoned begin to weaken, adventurers are drawn into a world filled with ancient mysteries, dangerous creatures, forgotten ruins, and powerful beings. Players must explore the lands of Kaldraen, uncover the secrets surrounding Eldrius, and forge their own path through a world where danger and adventure await at every turn.
summary: Eldrius Online is a medieval fantasy MMORPG featuring exploration, real-time combat, quests, dungeons, character progression, PvP and guild-based gameplay. Players explore a dangerous world filled with creatures, bosses, challenges and treasures.
